# Set A (1000 words) -> assigned to Cursor.  Set B (1,000) -> handled separately.
# These 1000 Thai words are ALREADY VERIFIED UNIQUE against the existing
# were dropped during generation because they collided. DO NOT re-check needed —
# but DO NOT substitute your own words either. Use exactly this list.
# For EACH of the 1000 rows below, produce one Swift ThaiWord entry:
# IDs continue from the existing data: start at 2447, increment by 1, no gaps.
# Append to the existing array in ThaiWallpaperLearn/Shared/Vocabulary.swift.
# PLUS: 2-3 example sentences per word, in the same structure the existing
# examples use (thai / romanization / english / hindi). Every word needs them.
# RULE 1 — ROMANIZATION (this is where the last batch went wrong)
# Match the EXISTING baseline style exactly. Reference rows from ids 1-1046:
#     ขอบคุณ  ->  khop-khun      (tones: khòp-khun)
#     สวัสดี   ->  sa-wat-dii     (tones: sà-wàt-dii)
#     เรือ     ->  ruea           (baseline has "rʉa" in 5 stray rows — do NOT copy
#                                  those; they are the exception, not the rule)
#     ห้องครัว  ->  hoong-khrua    (tones: hôong-khrua)
#     เหลือง   ->  lueang         (tones: lǔeang)
#       FORBIDDEN characters:  ʉ  ɔ  ə  ɛ  ɤ
#   1b. Syllables joined by HYPHENS. Never spaces.
#       WRONG: gaan, gài, gun-jae       RIGHT: kaan, kài, kun-jae
#       Verified against baseline: ก=k  ข/ค=kh  ต=t  ท/ถ=th  ป=p  พ/ผ=ph
#                                  จ=j  ด=d  บ=b  ง=ng  ญ/ย=y
#       (baseline: กิน=kin, ตา=taa, ปี=pii, จาก=jàak, บ้าน=bâan)
#       Long vowel ื = "ue" / "uue"  (baseline: คืน=khuen, ตื่น=tùuen)
#   1d. Tone marks go on the vowel: à á â ǎ  è é ê ě  ì í î ǐ  ò ó ô ǒ  ù ú û ǔ
#   1e. The SAME Thai syllable must romanize the same way everywhere.
#       (Last batch had ไกด์ as both "kai" and "gai" — do not repeat this.)
#   2a. Devanagari script only. No Latin letters anywhere in the field.
#   2b. Syllables joined by HYPHENS, mirroring the romanization:
#         ขอบคุณ -> खोब-कुन        สวัสดี -> स-वट-दी
#   2c. In compounds, न + ม is written नम (not न्म).
#   2d. The "er" vowel (เ-อ) uses  र्  — e.g. เดิน -> दर्न
#   2e. Unaspirated k/t/p stay क/त/प; aspirated kh/th/ph become ख/थ/फ.
#         กิน -> किन     ขอบ -> खोब     ไป -> पाइ
#   Natural Hindi, Devanagari only, no Latin. Add a disambiguator in
#   parentheses when the English is ambiguous, e.g.  खाना (क्रिया) for "to eat".
#   Two words must never share an identical englishMeaning — the Quiz and Speak
#   modes show the English and expect one Thai answer, so duplicates create
#   unanswerable questions. The last batch broke this ("red" = both แดง and สีแดง).
